items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 104:1
items.html: Because the Malchut of the Rosh does not make a conclusion upon the light; on the contrary, she makes a beginning for the light by means of the reflected light that ascends from her (as above in Item 204).
